focus_areas: Micro-texture of hackle feathers for repetitive patterns
Boundary integrity of the serrated comb against the background
Anatomical correctness of the eye and beak junction
Consistency of lighting on the fleshy parts (comb/wattle) vs. feathers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'texture_anomaly' noted in the hackle feathers. Real rooster hackles often have irregular barring; AI tends to make them perfectly uniform stripes. Also, verify if the comb's connection to the skull looks physically grounded or if it appears to float/fuse into the forehead feathers.

The plumage on the neck consists of long, pointed hackle feathers with a striking black-and-white striped pattern. The eye is sharp with an orange iris. The background is dark and out of focus, showing hints of iridescent blue/green feathers from another bird or the same bird's body.
